_meta.title: Greece residential property price list (asking prices) for nad-lan.co.il
_meta.method: Primary value per place = Indomio.gr September 2026 asking price (one provider, one month, widest coverage, sale + rent + yoy). Where Indomio has no figure, the next source in this order: Spitogatos Q3 2026, Spitogatos SPI Q2 2026, Spitogatos Q2 2026 blog, xe.gr Q3 2026 (computed weighted mean), Spitogatos islands / holiday-homes / regional reports, RE/MAX, Numbeo. All other values kept in sale_alt / rent_alt. Asking prices are typically above transaction prices. gross_yield is computed only when sale and rent come from the same provider and month.
_meta.rent_filter: Indomio rents dropped as implausible when < 4 EUR/m2, yoy beyond +/-100%, or implying < 2% gross yield (seasonal islands, tiny samples).
_meta.raw: raw/ (indomio/, neighbourhoods/, regions/, market/, types/, numbeo/, xe_q3_2026.json, agent_*.json)
